title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Themify Themify…
description: Themify Builder versions up to 7.8.5 contain a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This flaw allows attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in the context of the victim's browser. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
